reviews.review: its like binding of isaac or gungeon but platformer and better!

Controls/Mechanics: Good, The characters have tight controls and I feel like I always have control over the character. The enemies are well programmed and have consistent movements and attacks that you can learn. 9/10

Sounds/Music: Good, The sound and music is crisp and nice to listen to repeatedly. 9/10

Graphics: Good, The art design is pleasing to look at and gives depth to the levels. Good art design and animations that you can understand how your characters and enemies hit boxes. 9/10

Difficultly: Good, The game is difficult to start off because a lot of things are locked off and you must quickly learn the game and have a strategy to progress. There are 3 difficulties to choose 
from and have large enough differences between each. 9/10

Story/ Writing: Ok, There is not much to the story if there is one, but still interesting, but not much is explained. 7/10

Length: Good, The length comes down to how long you want to play for and what your strategy is to win the game. It can range from 45 minutes and up if you have a longer session. 9/10

Replay Value: Good, You can change your strategy, different characters, different “artifacts” to enable or disable as you progress. There are a lot of things to change and make a new interesting experience. 9/10

Originality: Good, The game design is not like anything I have played before and is a great survival game. 9/10

Enjoyment: Good, I truly enjoyed the game and the experiences I have had out of it. It can cause frustration but you can learn from your mistakes. 9/10

Other Thoughts: If you are looking for a game that is easy then this game is not for you but if you are looking for a challenging survival game then you are in luck with a great game.
Total: 88/100 8.8/10

I somehow managed to waste 30 hours playing this game instead of studying for my college exams.
Fun to play, loads of characters and items to unlock, difficult as hell.
The BACK TO MAIN MENU button doesn't work in the stats menu and the game doesn't scale X2 on certain resolutions, which forced me to play it with super small sprites / zoomed out. But hey, I spent 30 hours playing it this way, so I guess the joke's on me.

Can't get past the opening level, it's a complete chore, not at all fun. The upgrades don't tell you what they'll do, and you only get to pick one so how are you supposed to know which? It feels like a level from near the end of the game where you already know what you're doing, not an introduction. Going by the other reviews it must get better once you get the hang of it, but the game hasn't given me any reason to stick with it.

First up just want to say this is a really great game, great to jump in and play in a free hour here and there, but since recently I have been unable to save my progress (even when playing on the hardest difficulty) and every time I jump back in I have to unlock everything all over again. This isn't an uncommon issue ont he forums but I couldn't find any kind of reliable fix so I can't recommend the game until that is sorted.
